story.text: 다음 만남에서 그는 나를 반포대교로 데려갔다. '오늘은 좀 특별한 데를 보여주고 싶어서요.' 그가 웃으며 말했다.
story.reading: da-eum man-nam-e-seo geu-neun na-reul ban-po-dae-gyo-ro de-ryeo-gat-da. o-neul-eun jom teuk-byeol-han de-reul bo-yeo-ju-go sip-eo-seo-yo. geu-ga us-eu-myeo mal-haet-da.
story.en: On our next meeting, he took me to Banpo Bridge. "I wanted to show you somewhere a little special today," he said, smiling.

story.text: 다리 아래로 펼쳐진 한강 야경이, 달빛 분수의 물줄기와 함께 반짝였다. 규현은 말없이 그 풍경을 바라보고 있었다.
story.reading: da-ri a-rae-ro pyeol-chyeo-jin han-gang ya-gyeong-i, dal-bit bun-su-ui mul-jul-gi-wa ham-kke ban-jjag-yeot-da. gyu-hyeon-eun mal-eop-si geu pung-gyeong-eul ba-ra-bo-go iss-eot-da.
story.en: The Han River night view spread out beneath the bridge, sparkling together with the jets of the moonlight rainbow fountain. Kyuhyun gazed at the scenery without a word.

story.text: 선선한 강바람이 불어왔다. 그는 슬쩍 내 쪽으로 손을 뻗더니, 조심스럽게 내 손을 잡았다.
story.reading: seon-seon-han gang-ba-ram-i bul-eo-wat-da. geu-neun seul-jjeok nae jjok-eu-ro son-eul ppeot-deo-ni, jo-sim-seu-reop-ge nae son-eul jab-at-da.
story.en: A cool river breeze blew past. He reached his hand toward me and carefully took hold of mine.

story.text: '이 정도 두근거림, 사실 오랜만이에요. 아니, 어쩌면 이런 느낌 자체가 처음인 것 같기도 하고.'
story.reading: i jeong-do du-geun-geo-rim, sa-sil o-raen-man-i-e-yo. a-ni, eo-jjeo-myeon i-reon neu-kkim ja-che-ga cheo-eum-in geot gat-gi-do ha-go.
story.en: "This kind of heart-pounding — honestly, it's been a while. Or, actually, maybe this feeling itself is something new to me."

story.text: 평소의 여유로운 미소 대신, 그의 얼굴엔 뭔가에 벅찬 듯한 표정이 스쳤다. 나는 그 낯선 얼굴에서 눈을 뗄 수 없었다.
story.reading: pyeong-so-ui yeo-yu-ro-un mi-so dae-sin, geu-ui eol-gul-en mwon-ga-e beok-chan deu-tan pyo-jeong-i seu-chyeot-da. na-neun geu nat-seon eol-gul-e-seo nun-eul ttel su eop-seot-da.
story.en: Instead of his usual easy smile, something like being quietly overwhelmed flickered across his face. I couldn't look away from that unfamiliar expression.

story.text: '저 원래 이런 거 잘 안 하는데… 오늘은 그냥 솔직하게 있고 싶네요. 아가씨 앞에서는, 자꾸 그러고 싶어져요.'
story.reading: jeo won-lae i-reon geo jal an ha-neun-de… o-neul-eun geu-nyang sol-jik-ha-ge it-go sip-ne-yo. a-ga-ssi ap-e-seo-neun, ja-kku geu-reo-go sip-eo-jyeo-yo.
story.en: "I don't usually do this kind of thing... but today, I just want to be honest. In front of you, I keep wanting to be like this."

story.text: 늘 장난과 여유 뒤에 숨어 있던 그가, 처음으로 아무 방패도 없이 내 앞에 서 있었다. 나는 잡은 손에 살며시 힘을 주었다.
story.reading: neul jang-nan-gwa yeo-yu dwi-e sum-eo iss-deon geu-ga, cheo-eum-eu-ro a-mu bang-pae-do eop-si nae ap-e seo iss-eot-da. na-neun jab-eun son-e sal-myeo-si him-eul ju-eot-da.
story.en: The man who always hid behind jokes and easy charm was, for the first time, standing before me with no shield at all. I gently tightened my grip on his hand.

words.example_en: The Han River night view was truly beautiful.
The heart-pounding grew stronger when he took my hand.
My heart felt overwhelmed in that moment.
He spoke honestly for the first time.
